fileProfiles.summary: Documents the placeholder deployment environment variables needed for the web application, Supabase, email delivery, Telegram, and push notifications without containing live credentials.
Defines repository-level Git attribute handling for tracked artifacts.
Pins the Node.js runtime family expected by local development and build tooling.

Defines HETU-specific knowledge-graph scan exclusions for secrets, machine-local deployment state, generated build and test artifacts, analysis outputs, large PYQ datasets, and binary study assets while retaining commented cross-language test-pattern examples.
Stores the minimal Understand-Anything project analysis configuration for this repository.
Records two repository working agreements covering task-scoped commits, pushes to origin, and protection of unrelated changes.
Keeps the otherwise empty Android stub directory represented in version control.
Explains how HETU is packaged and released as a local-bundle Capacitor Android app, including Firebase push setup, signing, device verification, app links, and performance budgets.
Configures the Android application module, including its Android build settings, application plugin, dependencies, release processing, Capacitor integration, and Google Services plugin.
Provides the Capacitor-specific Android module configuration and dependency wiring applied by the main application Gradle build.
Supplies Android Google Services and Firebase client metadata consumed by the Gradle plugin during application builds.
Provides application-specific Android shrinker and obfuscation rules layered onto the release build.
Provides the generated Android instrumentation smoke test that verifies the application context package on a device or emulator.
Declares the Android application, main deep-link activity, push messaging service, notification action receivers, file provider, and required platform capabilities.
Extends Capacitor Firebase messaging to render HETU buddy and study notifications with channels, safe deep links, inline replies, and authenticated action buttons.
Captures bounded Android inline-reply text, updates notification state, and enqueues unique network-constrained delivery work.
Posts an inline buddy reply to a validated HTTPS endpoint with retry-aware WorkManager results and notification delivery feedback.
Hosts the Capacitor bridge, performs a one-time legacy service-worker cleanup, and safely translates supported app links into WebView routes.
Validates notification action inputs, shows progress state, and enqueues unique network-constrained API work without opening the app.
Executes token-authenticated notification actions against validated HTTPS endpoints with bounded retries and action-specific completion feedback.
Defines the Android version-24 vector foreground artwork supplied by the generated launcher resource set.
Defines the scalable Android launcher foreground artwork as a grouped three-path vector using the HETU mark and brand palette.
Defines the Android splash drawable as a branded paper-color layer with a centered launcher foreground mark.
Defines the full-canvas paper-colored vector background used behind the adaptive Android launcher foreground.
Defines a compact monochrome HETU vector mark suitable for Android status-bar notification icons.
Defines the main Android activity layout as a full-screen WebView inside a CoordinatorLayout.
Defines the round adaptive launcher icon using the same configured background and foreground layers.
Defines the standard adaptive launcher icon by combining configured background and foreground resources.
Defines the Android application color resources for the burgundy primary and accent, paper background, dark ink, and gold brand palette.
Defines the paper-colored background resource used by the adaptive Android launcher icon.
Centralizes Android application identity, custom URL scheme, notification channel labels, reply prompts, action feedback, and mute or reminder status text.
Defines the base, no-action-bar, and splash themes for the native Android shell, including system bar appearance, brand background colors, and launch drawables.
Defines the external and cache path roots exposed through the application FileProvider.
Provides the generated local Android unit-test smoke check for the Java test harness.
Root Android Gradle build configuration that declares build plugins and repositories, loads shared version variables, and provides the project clean task.
Generated Capacitor settings fragment that registers the native bridge and installed Android plugin modules with the Gradle project graph.
Project-wide Gradle properties controlling build-process JVM behavior and AndroidX compatibility for the native Android build.
Contains the binary Gradle wrapper bootstrap used to launch the repository-pinned build distribution.
Configures the Gradle wrapper distribution and its local storage behavior.
Implements the generated Unix launcher that discovers Java and starts the pinned Gradle wrapper.
Windows Gradle wrapper launcher that resolves the project directory and Java runtime, invokes the pinned wrapper bootstrap, forwards command-line arguments, and propagates its exit status.
Documents placeholder Android signing-property names for a local keystore path, aliases, and passwords without containing production signing secrets.
Android Gradle settings entry point that assembles the application, Capacitor bridge, and generated plugin settings into one multi-module build.
Centralized Android build-version catalog for SDK levels and the AndroidX, Firebase, Cordova, unit-test, and instrumentation-test dependencies.
Configures HETU’s Capacitor Android shell to load the production HTTPS host, disable unsafe WebView behavior, and tune keyboard, splash-screen, and push-notification plugins.
Provides an end-to-end production deployment runbook for Supabase, edge functions, secrets, authentication, Vercel, cron schedules, smoke testing, operations, and rollback.
Defines the Vite application shell, preloads branding, restores the preferred color theme before React hydration, and mounts the client entry point at the root element.
Defines the Node 22 ESM package, Vite and TypeScript build commands, test and deployment scripts, Capacitor Android workflows, and the application dependency set.
Runs Chromium end-to-end tests against a managed local Vite server with serial execution, CI retries and reporting, and first-retry tracing.
Enables Tailwind CSS processing and vendor-prefix generation in the PostCSS pipeline.
Publishes the Android Digital Asset Links statement authorizing the signed HETU application package to handle URLs for the hosting domain.

Handles web-push delivery and notification clicks inside the service worker, validating payload fields, presenting legacy or supplied actions, managing app badges, securely invoking API actions, and focusing or opening the routed client.

Introduces HETU as a local-first GATE PYQ analysis and buddy-study application, then covers setup, account access, data isolation, product philosophy, stack, testing, deployment, and Android distribution.
Audits the generated 3,200-question PYQ bank for version, ID, subject and topic counts, classifier consistency, and retention of every manual content correction.
Validates release version inputs and JDK 21, then builds and stages both the production-signed Android release APK and a debug-certificate friend-update variant.
Transforms the first learner-provided GO Classes COA topic-test attempt set into an idempotent SQL migration for PYQ receipts, journal questions, and D3 reattempt rows.

Converts a learner’s 15-question GO Classes COA Topic Test 2 log into an idempotent Supabase SQL migration that preserves immutable PYQ receipts, journal questions, and scheduled D3 re-attempts after validating answer evidence.

Builds the audited 3,200-question GATE PYQ archive by combining GateQA, GATE Overflow, ExamSIDE supplements, and learner-provided tests, then classifying questions, localizing images, and writing subject shards, manifest, and provenance data.
Builds the curated GATE topper-notes archive by validating source PDFs, compressing large documents with Ghostscript, copying the linear-algebra lab, and generating the public metadata manifest.
Reclassifies the complete generated PYQ corpus with the canonical taxonomy, rewrites subject payloads and manifest counts, and emits a manual-correction audit without changing the question ID set.

Performs an idempotent Supabase backend deployment by validating credentials and CLI access, linking the project, rotating Vault cron secrets, applying migrations, deploying edge functions, setting optional secrets, and configuring Telegram.
Defines the versioned 95-topic PYQ taxonomy, audited manual overrides, and tag-and-content classifiers that map each question into a canonical GATE subject and topic.
Verifies study-analysis calculations for mistake-surface history, outcomes, sessions, due work, weekly summaries, heatmaps, calibration, and active-day streaks against fixed evidence.
Verifies that saved answers stay out of the rendered page until explicitly revealed and that an absent answer exposes the add action.
Exercises the buddy chat composer and scrolling behavior, including pointer-specific Enter handling, hidden-conversation read state, and jump-to-latest affordances.
Validates buddy notification client helpers for stable device identity, explicit opt-in defaults, VAPID key decoding, and safe local push routes.
Verifies that mobile buddy-chat navigation is URL-driven and that native Back returns from a conversation to the buddy list.
Covers buddy-domain helpers for safe shared-question payloads, message merging and grouping, pair-scoped presence, and compact chat timestamps.
Validates route-to-coaching-tip selection for all supported study surfaces, trailing slashes, dynamic session routes, and unknown-screen fallback behavior.
Verifies JWT role-claim extraction for valid service-role tokens, non-service roles, malformed tokens, and missing claims.
Exercises timezone-aware digest clock calculation and the grace-window logic that decides when a scheduled digest is due.
Verifies the Do Now queue prioritizes due retrieval, analysis, uncertainty, speed, formulas, and planned work while omitting completed blocks and already analyzed PYQs.
Verifies that the local-first sandbox reaches the dashboard, every practical study-loop route renders its expected heading, and the core mobile navigation remains visible at phone width.

Validates the 15-question GO Classes COA Topic Test 2 import against its official answers and topic taxonomy, including skip and correctness semantics. It also checks that the corresponding Supabase migration preserves learner answers, actual answers, and durable receipt records.

Regression-tests the second GO Classes COA screenshot archive by verifying all fifteen questions use bundled answer-free practice images while retaining separate full attempt receipts. It also checks that the follow-up migration writes practice-image paths, never result-receipt paths, into re-attempt and journal image fields.
Ensures each question in the original GO Classes COA Topic Test embeds its answer-free practice screenshot and never exposes the corresponding attempt receipt image in question HTML.
Checks element screenshot capture behavior and confirms that light-mode styling is isolated to the cloned capture document.
Exercises the full device-isolation contract by seeding persisted Zustand state, IndexedDB rows, metadata, and localStorage before verifying an account-safe wipe.
Verifies that the Journal initially includes a standalone imported question, renders its pattern and attached image action, and reports the correct entry count under a mocked signed-in sandbox user.
Checks that dashboard learning tips choose one complementary, evidence-driven recommendation without duplicating the visible due queue and provide a useful empty-data default.
Covers missing-tag save behavior, whitespace normalization, confirmation action priority, and direct saving of Session questions without an unnecessary popup.
Exercises the mock-test form end to end, including total validation, Dexie persistence, recorded mistakes, confirmed deletion, and empty state.
Validates mock-exam input integrity and derived reporting for normalized score, answered accuracy, best and worst attempts, and latest-score movement.
Guards the Android document-scroll fix by asserting that the native body uses horizontal overflow clipping instead of a hidden overflow container.
Tests native deep-link normalization and Android Back policy across history navigation, deep-linked pages, and double-press exit behavior.
Enforces source-level notification consent boundaries and fallback behavior across daily digests, Buddy pushes and requests, device study settings, and Android interactive delivery.
Verifies the native notification-time editor uses bounded in-page numeric inputs instead of Android select dialogs.
Tests staged hour and minute editing, atomic time saves, and restoration of persisted values after a failed save.
Validates numeric keyboard hints, one-character PIN cells, and removal of non-digit input.
Verifies cloud range loading accepts only structurally valid Planner sessions and returns sanitized cloud-only plans for requested dates.
Checks user-scoped Planner storage isolation, one-time claiming of legacy rows, and strict ISO-date parsing for deep links.
Tests planner-mode routing, duration-weighted completion, protection against overlong blocks masking unfinished work, and reconciliation from persisted sessions into exact planner blocks.
Exercises Android Planner sheets, protecting dialogs from WebView-retargeted backdrop taps and covering a complete native session creation flow.
Tests the portalled Planner subject picker, including searchable selection and continued editing of a custom subject name.
Verifies comprehensive progress metrics, spreadsheet-safe CSV output, numeric values, and strict user scoping during report collection.
Exercises committed PYQ attempt persistence, including atomic answer and snapshot capture, canonical journal grouping, compatible bank-version resume, and saved-set discard.
Verifies PYQ history filters use the latest attempt and correctly distinguish unseen, wrong, guessed, slow, skipped, repeated, and analyzed questions.
Audits the production PYQ migration text for one-active-session enforcement, immutable version-two attempt receipts, and removal of the delete policy.
Tests PYQ practice navigation rules that lock committed answers while allowing a previously skipped question to be answered after revisiting it.
Tests archived PYQ HTML repair and KaTeX rendering for tables, bare math environments, legacy delimiters, matrices, eqalign syntax, and full answer choices.
Verifies deterministic PYQ session and attempt IDs, timer restoration, progress transitions, completion and abandonment, canonical session projection, skips, snapshots, and re-attempt receipts.
Covers PYQ text flattening, MCQ/MSQ/NAT grading, answer logging, image embedding, inferred outcomes, practice scope, manifest compatibility, HTML normalization, and bundled-bank integrity.
Checks that the shared question-draft pipeline starts with a blank answer and trims, persists, and reloads entered solution text.
Exercises quick image capture, outcome and mistake entry, question persistence, and creation of the linked D3 re-attempt.
Covers account-isolated readiness history, prior-week comparisons, and the minimum sample span required for exam projection.
Exercises readiness subscores, evidence tempering, client/server parity, per-subject breakdowns, recommendations, AIR bands, and deterministic exam simulation.

Exercises the end-to-end re-attempt UI for logged and PYQ questions, including legacy restoration, answer locking, skipped-question revisits, queue entry, automatic scheduling, numeric input, and image preview.
Covers the spaced re-attempt ladder, answer evaluation, queue partitioning, duplicate prevention, and Dexie-backed result persistence.
Checks that revision-pack generation prioritizes due retrieval work and recurring mistake patterns.
Tests session-history database queries, pruning of empty completed sessions, preservation of running work, and reconciliation of legacy PYQ practice into canonical journal grouping.
Bootstraps browser-like Vitest state with fake IndexedDB, DOM matchers, resilient in-memory local and session storage, and a no-op ResizeObserver for chart rendering.
Validates study-plan parsing and concise notification copy for detailed day plans and daily PYQ reminders.
Validates study-notification category coverage, minute-level scheduling, separate consent, interactive actions, and schedule-reset semantics.
Checks Supabase URL validation for supported project URLs and rejects missing, placeholder, or unsafe values without throwing.
Validates offline-first synchronization, ordered pushes, queued deletes, local-pending conflict resolution, parallel pulls, and overlapping refresh deduplication.
Covers Telegram command parsing, timezone date helpers, timetable and digest renderers, message limits, and deterministic motivational content.
Tests explicit and system theme resolution, semantic DOM and browser-chrome updates, and direct light/dark toggling.
Verifies topic-evidence classification for untouched, manually studied, strong, and revision-needed states while combining PYQ and journal evidence without double counting.
Verifies user-scoped topic completion timestamps and removal when a syllabus topic is unticked.
Validates the topper-notes manifest’s size, ordering, unique identifiers and links, then confirms every PDF and the linear-algebra lab are present and byte-synchronized.
Composes the application root, initializes authentication and preferences, synchronizes the resolved theme with browser and native chrome, and mounts global runtimes around the router.
Renders a controlled, configurable numeric PIN as individual cells with focus movement, keyboard navigation, paste handling, and digit sanitization.
Displays a buddy initial with deterministic color styling, responsive sizing, and an optional online-presence indicator.
Implements the responsive real-time buddy conversation surface with message pagination, optimistic sending, typing and read state, presence, question sharing, and unfriend controls.
Maintains Supabase Presence channels for active buddy relationships and projects synchronized online user IDs into the buddy presence store.
Renders the dashboard hero with a time-sensitive greeting, queue-aware next-move message, primary action, overdue context, date, and optional exam countdown.
Displays the highest-priority evidence-based learning tip with tone-specific accent styling and hides itself when no tip is available.
Visualizes nonzero last-session outcome counts as an accessible Recharts donut with a centered total question count.
Provides an animated, keyboard-dismissible popover explaining each outcome code, color, and re-attempt implication.
Plots the trailing open mistake surface as an accessible step-area chart with computed bounds, formatted dates, and detailed hover values.
Presents a multi-slide onboarding overlay and persists dismissal locally and to the signed-in user profile.
Implements mobile primary navigation with three tabs, a context-aware central session action, haptic feedback, and an animated grouped More sheet.
Builds the desktop side navigation, grouping study and analysis routes while resolving live-session resume state and authenticated profile controls.
Renders the standard page heading, optional description and actions, and a mobile brand mark with shared responsive spacing.
Composes the authenticated responsive shell, starts synchronization, mounts desktop and mobile navigation, animates routed content, and adds contextual tips and daily quotes.
Combines exam countdown, offline synchronization status, and theme switching into the desktop and mobile shell control cluster.
Bridges Capacitor app lifecycle events into the web application, handling Android Back, deep links, keyboard dismissal, native chrome, and sync resume.
Keeps push registration synchronized and routes native notification actions into application navigation for authenticated users.
Renders a stable six-week monthly Planner grid with a minimum date boundary, today highlighting, plan-duration summaries, subject chips, native haptics, and responsive labels.
Provides the day-plan view and editor for sessions and end-of-day review, with auto-persisted changes, execution actions, native-safe dismissal, and confirmed clearing.
Displays local 30-day Planner rollups for volume, completion, subject, mode, priority, repeatability, and neglected subjects with native and desktop layouts.
Implements a searchable, portalled subject dialog designed for reliable use inside Android WebView sheets, with focus management, body scroll locking, and haptic selection.
Normalizes and sanitizes archived PYQ HTML before rendering it, then applies tolerant KaTeX auto-rendering to supported inline and display delimiters.
Provides the owner-facing access request queue with status tabs, approval and decline workflows, invite-link recovery, reasons, and copy controls.
Manages buddy-message notification consent and delivery state, including device guidance, temporary snoozing, and foreground-preview preferences.
Configures daily digest delivery through Telegram and email, including connection lifecycle, local schedule and timezone, backup preference, and test sends.
Edits an hour-and-minute notification schedule with native numeric controls, web selects, bounded values, staged changes, and asynchronous save recovery.
Controls separate study-notification consent and per-category schedules, with preference persistence and interactive test delivery.
Keeps a saved solution concealed for active recall, toggles an accessible reveal panel, and offers an add action when no answer exists.
Defines the reusable HETU brand mark and size-aware wordmark used across navigation, loading, authentication, and error surfaces.
Renders a route-specific GATE coaching card with contextual copy, accessible labeling, and subject-ink-inspired tone styling.
Renders a deterministic motivational quote selected from the current date and authenticated user, giving the shared shell stable daily encouragement.
Provides a full-screen animated question-image viewer with keyboard, wheel, double-click, drag-to-pan, and two-finger pinch zoom controls.
Shows the branded application loading screen with motion that respects the user reduced-motion preference.
Presents a warning dialog before saving without both pattern and trigger cues, emphasizing return-to-tagging while allowing an explicit override.
Shows a quiet sandbox, offline, or queued-sync status and remains hidden when the app is online and fully synchronized.
Renders a compact outcome-code badge using the configured semantic tone and descriptive label.
Defines the editable question shape and converts between persisted question rows, normalized editor drafts, and new-question defaults.
Edits the complete question draft, including source metadata, prompt and answer, compressed image, result analysis, decision data, date, and timing.
Guards protected content behind authentication readiness, rendering a loading screen until the auth hook permits access.
Renders the router-level failure screen and performs a guarded one-time reload when a deployment leaves the browser with stale dynamic chunk URLs.
Edits or deletes an existing study session, synchronizes changes locally, and safely orphans its questions instead of deleting them.
Provides an accessible light/dark theme toggle that resolves system preference, persists the selected mode, and adds native haptic feedback.
Displays elapsed time against a target with visual urgency states and compact clock formatting.
Renders all outcome choices as tag options and supports direct keyboard selection plus Escape cancellation.
Implements pattern tagging with subject-weighted fuzzy suggestions, keyboard navigation, creation of new names, skip behavior, and embedded naming guidance.
Renders the root-cause choices in the tagging flow and supports number-key selection and Escape navigation.
Defines the source-capture draft and creates a new GATE PYQ-oriented default with current year and set metadata.
Implements the source-capture step for tagging a question, with subject and exam metadata, prompt and answer text, image compression, marks, format, and keyboard shortcuts.
Coordinates the keyboard-first source, outcome, pattern, trigger, and root-cause workflow, including animated navigation, native back handling, and local-first save state.
Provides a reusable keyboard-labeled tagging choice with semantic tones, selected styling, and haptic feedback.
Captures the exact question phrase that should cue a method, with focused keyboard submission, skip behavior, and explanatory guidance.
Provides a reusable badge primitive with semantic color tones and composable styling.
Defines the reusable button primitive with visual variants, size presets, forwarded refs, disabled behavior, and optional haptic feedback.
Provides card container, header, and body primitives used to structure elevated content panels.
Renders an accessible animated modal dialog with backdrop dismissal, Escape handling, body-scroll locking, and focus restoration.
Renders a consistent empty-state panel with optional hint, action, and custom styling.
Provides a styled, ref-forwarding input primitive with optional monospaced numeric presentation.
Renders keyboard shortcuts with a compact keycap visual treatment.
Renders an accessible bounded progress bar with accent and semantic tone variants.
Provides a styled, ref-forwarding native select primitive for forms.
Renders a compact tab selector with native haptic feedback, keyboard-friendly buttons, and active-state styling.
Provides a styled, ref-forwarding multiline text input primitive.
Mounts the animated global toast stack, maps toast tones to styling, and triggers success or error haptics once per notification.
Selects the authenticated user identity, status, and sandbox mode from the central auth store.
Registers guarded global keyboard shortcuts while ignoring modified keystrokes and events originating from editable controls.
Exposes a reactive media-query hook with server-safe initialization and listener cleanup when the query changes.
Provides hooks that bootstrap user synchronization, track browser connectivity, and count rows still pending or errored across synchronized tables.
Returns drift-resistant elapsed seconds derived from an epoch start time and refreshed twice per second.
Invokes a current callback when the document becomes hidden, with optional runtime enablement.

Implements HETU’s global Tailwind-backed design system with light and dark tokens, typography, safe-area and native WebView behavior, responsive components, tables, print rules, reduced-motion support, and PYQ and topper-notes content styling.
Provides deterministic dashboard and weekly-review analytics for mistake surface, outcomes, calibration, heatmaps, weekly summaries, and active study days.
Exports user-owned Dexie data into a versioned JSON envelope, downloads it through the browser, and safely merges valid backup rows back into local-first storage.
Provides pure Buddy messaging helpers for realtime topic names, privacy-safe shared question references, message merging, conversation grouping, and compact timestamps.
Coordinates web and native push registration for Buddy and study channels, persists per-device opt-ins, invokes notification services, and manages quiet-hour snoozes.
Defines the shared GATE subjects, outcomes, root causes, source types, exam ranges, question formats, timing targets, and application defaults.
Defines the curated route-aware GATE preparation tip catalog and resolves dynamic or normalized paths to the appropriate coaching message.
Defines the versioned Dexie database, local row types, synchronized table order, compound indexes, and helpers used as the application’s primary offline data store.
Builds the ordered study-action queue from due re-attempts, unanalyzed or uncertain PYQs, slow correct work, formula reviews, and incomplete Planner blocks.
Supplies typed client wrappers around Supabase Edge Functions for access requests, invite approval, username/PIN authentication, PIN recovery, and Buddy requests.
Defines the UI freeze date and a helper that determines whether a supplied or current date falls after the freeze deadline.
Converts, captures, resizes, and compresses study images into bounded JPEG data URLs for the offline-first question store.
Performs a best-effort device wipe across persisted Zustand stores, application-owned localStorage keys, and the Dexie database to prevent cross-account residue.
Wraps React lazy imports with one-time reload recovery for stale deployment chunks while preserving ordinary module-load errors.
Applies deterministic coaching rules to recent learner evidence and returns one focused dashboard learning tip.
Validates mock-test input and calculates score, accuracy, best/worst/latest performance, and score movement summaries.
Exposes the shared quote catalog through browser-facing aliases and provides deterministic daily and random quote selection helpers.
Centralizes Capacitor platform detection, best-effort haptics, system chrome styling, deep-link parsing, and Android back-button policy.
Provides a compatibility alias for motivational one-liners and deterministic date-and-seed selection.
Reconciles a question pattern against live question counts, updating an existing pattern or creating its initial persisted metadata.
Mirrors the session portion of Planner days to Supabase, validating remote session payloads and supporting single-day or date-range load, upsert, and deletion.
Defines Planner subjects, durations, study modes, priorities, break patterns, day types, energy and mood choices, calendar bounds, and deterministic subject-chip colors.
Connects Planner blocks to PYQ, mock, and focused-session routes, records block execution, derives completion percentage, and reconciles linked Dexie records back into plans.
Loads local Planner days and computes pure cross-day rollups for time, sessions, subject/mode/priority shares, reviews, neglected subjects, day types, and time windows.
Defines the DayPlan data model and user-scoped localStorage persistence, including defaults, legacy-key migration, safe reads and writes, monthly indexes, and day summaries.
Collects learner-owned local data and builds a versioned, spreadsheet-friendly progress report across sessions, journal, planner, PYQs, revision, readiness, syllabus, and focus metrics.
Groups PYQ attempts and filters question-bank items by unseen, repeated, incorrect, guessed, slow, skipped, or unanalyzed history.
Defines the durable PYQ session and attempt state machine, deterministic audit identifiers, immutable snapshots, journal linkage, and canonical practice sessions.
Loads and normalizes the bundled PYQ bank, repairs question math markup, evaluates answers, formats evidence, and derives journal text, images, sources, and outcomes.
Creates the shared TanStack Query client with retry, freshness, and window-focus refetch defaults for remote data.
Defines the missing-tag confirmation policy; the current policy allows saving without pattern or trigger confirmation.
Persists local readiness snapshots, computes weekly movement and exam projections, and tracks long-running weak-component debt overall and by subject.
Computes evidence-tempered overall and per-subject exam readiness, component contributions, prioritized next moves, coarse AIR bands, and deterministic exam-day simulations.
Implements the offline-compatible D3–D10–D30 reattempt ladder, answer evaluation, due-queue construction, scheduling, and result persistence.
Builds a prioritized revision pack from weekly fixes, formulas, trigger phrases, repeated mistakes, and due questions and renders it as plain text.
Reconciles audited PYQ practice into canonical sessions and returns only meaningful finished session history while pruning empty records.
Defines study-reminder categories and manages their Supabase-backed schedule preferences, validation, and test delivery.
Maps GATE subjects to static Tailwind color tokens used consistently across subject-aware visualizations and controls.
Defines the canonical GATE CS subtopic taxonomy, syllabus ordering, and selected cross-subject relationships used by topic pickers and progress views.
Validates Supabase environment configuration and creates a persistent auth client while retaining a local-only fallback that keeps the app bootable.
Runs the local-first Dexie-to-Supabase synchronization engine with FK-ordered pushes, queued deletes, conflict-aware pulls, retry backoff, and lifecycle listeners.
Resolves system-aware color modes and applies the selected theme to document data attributes, form controls, and PWA chrome metadata.
Combines PYQ attempts, journal questions, re-attempts, and study timestamps into an evidence-based topic status and accuracy summary.
Provides shared class merging, identifiers, timezone-aware date handling, duration formatting, debouncing, fuzzy distance, clamping, and pluralization helpers.
Bootstraps the React application and manages deployment freshness by disabling service workers in native builds and polling for PWA updates on the web.
Implements the username-and-PIN sign-in screen, input validation, authenticated redirects, and a development sandbox fallback when Supabase is unavailable.
Implements the responsive Buddy workspace for chats, incoming and outgoing requests, paused relationships, live previews, realtime updates, and mobile chat navigation.
Analyzes mark/skip/50-50 decisions under negative marking, shows overall and subject calibration, and lets learners classify or reset unresolved decisions with undo support.
Builds the learner dashboard from live local data, showing daily targets, readiness cues, mistake-surface movement, outcomes, coaching, and current priorities.
Displays an internal gallery of the project’s reusable buttons, inputs, badges, keyboard hints, progress, tabs, cards, empty states, toasts, and dialogs.
Presents the learner’s ordered Do Now queue from live Dexie evidence and today’s plan, marks planned work as started, and routes each action into its working flow.

Manages a subject-grouped formula library and a spaced review queue with recalled, forgotten, edit, and delete workflows.
Builds a date-filtered weakness heatmap across subjects, subtopics, and root causes, with intensity-scaled cells that navigate to matching journal entries.

Implements the learner question journal with live local queries, session reconciliation, fuzzy search, multidimensional filters, pagination, expandable evidence, image and answer review, and question or session editing.
Drives persistent single-question and multi-question logging flows, creates log-only sessions, reconciles patterns and reattempts, and supports editing recent entries.
Records and edits mock-test scores, subject marks, mistakes, accuracy metrics, history trends, and planner completion state.
Renders the application 404 page with theme control and a direct route back to the dashboard.
Aggregates the live pattern library by subject, highlights repeated misses and open reattempts, suggests near-duplicate merges, and supports reversible consolidation.
Coordinates the calendar, day editor, and insights with user-scoped local-first persistence, execution reconciliation, deep links, and debounced two-way Supabase session mirroring.
Implements the full PYQ practice experience: set configuration, history filtering, timed navigation, answer decisions, audit receipts, tagging, journaling, and re-attempt scheduling.
Captures a question image and minimum outcome evidence, compresses the image, and persists a standalone question with any required reattempt.
Composes the exam-readiness score, component evidence, next moves, trend projection, per-subject matrix, peer context, and clearly qualified exam-day simulations.
Implements the due re-attempt queue and dedicated logged-question and PYQ test sessions, including timers, answer history, immutable receipts, navigation recovery, and ladder grading.

Consumes a Supabase recovery session, validates matching six-digit PINs, updates the credential, and signs out before returning to login.
Builds and displays a focused weekly revision pack of due formulas, trigger phrases, repeated mistakes, priority questions, and the current constraint.

Configures and starts a focused session from preferences or planner parameters, creating its local session row and execution linkage.
